message: Duplicate caller-provided task ids corrupted the write-scope registry and ledger.
resolution: findDuplicateTaskId() rejects dupes in-batch and against in-flight tasks (ledger running + pool.isTaskActive) with structured result:'duplicate-task-id'. Test 47.

message: Ledger recorded the detected backend, not the executed one.
resolution: task.backend/state.swarm.backend always record the executed engine (pi-subprocess); detection rides on task.detectedBackend/swarm.detectedBackend/details.detectedBackend. Test 46.

message: dispatchOne captured the shared state manager: old batch events wrote into new runs; prune-on-access SIGTERMed live in-flight writers.
resolution: Records tagged with dispatch-time runId; recordSubagent* no-op with warning on mismatch; shutdownRunAgentPools wired into lifecycle markSucceeded/markCompletedBlocked and /goal-reset; pool acquired after the gate. Test 53.

message: Cancelling a queued task didn't stop it; it executed and was then labeled cancelled.
resolution: submit() refuses cancelled ids; cancel() on a queued id pre-empts admission; ledger records cancelled_before_admission and the task never executes. Test 50.

message: /goal-swarm-cancel reported success for nonexistent task ids; zero smoke coverage.
resolution: pool.cancel returns running|queued|unknown; command reports each case distinctly. Test 51.

message: §5.4 lease expiry unenforced: CapabilityLease.expiresAt was dead metadata.
resolution: policy engine honors input.leaseTtlMs; dispatch passes budget.timeoutMs so lease expiry == budget timeout; enforcement = pool SIGTERM + scope release, documented in run-pool.ts; maxAttempts retry deferred (documented).

message: Scalar Scout schema failure discarded the actual findings (stderr preferred over outputText).
resolution: Schema-validation failure degrades to ok:true + degraded:true with outputText preserved and note in stderr; surfaced as details.degraded. Test 48.

message: Test 45 benchmarked AgentPool.map, not the shipped parallel loop; no overlap proof.
resolution: Test 45 relabeled dispatch-wall-time-only; Test 49 proves production-loop overlap (2 spawns pending at concurrency:2 before any finish).

message: Feature flag read from caller-controlled params.cwd.
resolution: loadSwarmConfig reads ctx.cwd only. Test 52: crafted settings in passed cwd cannot enable swarm modes.

message: Crash left tasks running forever in state and on the swarm line.
resolution: restore() sweeps orphaned running tasks to failed/error:'process_restart' via hash-chained subagent_finished events; replay stays pure. Test 53.

message: Parallel mode re-implemented AgentPool.map inline; map dead in production.
resolution: dispatchAgentTask() extracted to src/agents/run-pool.ts and shared by all modes; parallel keeps an inline loop because each task must gate through the broker (documented); overlap proven by Test 49.

message: Test 40 chain artifact assertion was header-only.
resolution: Test 40 now asserts predecessor content (claims payload) in the successor prompt.

message: loadSwarmConfig crashed on a settings file containing literal null.
params.agent silently ignored; fallback backendKind drifted from 'none'.
resolution: Scalar fallback honors params.agent; backendKind:'none' restored on the no-backend path.

message: Pool entry reused without checking cwd.
One-task parallel batch ledgered as mode parallel.
resolution: One-task parallel/chain normalized to single before any ledger write.

message: phase-indicator folded cancelled into failed while /goal-status counted separately.
resolution: /goal-status folds cancelled into failed (matches indicator); per-status counts kept in details.

message: Stateless runId shared one pool across run boundaries with no ledger trace.
resolution: Stateless calls use a per-call pool shut down in finally — pre-C1 behavior preserved.
